About Jen

Hi, I’m Jen.

I’m a home baker in Wilmington, Illinois, and Sweet Treats Boutique is my little home bakery. I make homemade cake pops and specially designed treats — every one dipped, drizzled, and decorated by hand.

Whether it’s a weekday pick-me-up from the dessert cart or a custom order for a special day, I love making something sweet for my neighbors.

— Jen
